sources: https://www.cityofellinwoodks.com/departments/parks-recreation/ (City of Ellinwood, '(c) 2026'), read 2026-11-05: 'Wolf Pond & RV Park - The Wolf Pond & RV Park is located on the south side of Highway 56 (Santa Fe & Fritz) in Ellinwood. Wolf Pond is a popular destination for fishing enthusiasts. ... The RV Park has four sites available for rent. Each site has water and electric hook-ups, (20/30/50). Sites overlook Wolf Pond and this area is the gateway to two national wetland refuges. The hook-up fee is $8.00 per day. Payment can be made onsite or at the City Office located at 104 East 2nd in Ellinwood.'; city office 'Ph: (620) 564-3161'

Esri World Imagery at the stored pin 38.3536,-98.5882 (250 m half, with an upscaled crop), 2026-11-05: Wolf Pond lies between the railroad and a gravel lot beside the grain elevator, ~115 x 55 m; a dark-water pixel count over it gives ~4,300 m2 = ~1.05 acres (1-1.5 acres by eye). The gravel lot south of the pond sits ~10-35 m from its south shore across a grass bank with shoreline trees; I could not make out the four pedestals or any parked RV, so the pads are not located exactly. The pin is on the gravel road ~40 m west of that lot.
